description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating Go Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) related to import statements, including adding, deleting, rewriting, and checking usage of imports within Go source files.

methods.name: AddImport
methods.description: Adds an import path to the AST file if it is not already present.

methods.name: AddNamedImport
methods.description: Adds an import with a specific name and path to the AST file if absent.

methods.name: DeleteImport
methods.description: Deletes an import path from the AST file if it exists.

methods.name: DeleteNamedImport
methods.description: Deletes an import with a specific name and path from the AST file if it exists.

methods.name: RewriteImport
methods.description: Rewrites an existing import path to a new path within the AST file.

methods.name: UsesImport
methods.description: Checks if a specific import path is used in the AST file.

methods.name: Imports
methods.description: Returns grouped import specifications from the AST file.
